english translation text: THE CARAVAN OF PRISONERS HAS REACHED THE BAZAAR OF SHAM

arabic text: GUZREN GI KAISY ZAINAB BAZAAR E SHAM SY\nWAQIF NAHI HAIN BIBI PALWAAYE AAM SY
english translation text: HOW WILL BIBI ZAINAB(S.A.) PASS THROUGH THE BAZAR OF SHAM\nSHE IS NOT ACCUSTOMED TO BEING PARADED IN PUBLIC

arabic text:
AHMAD KI HAIN NAWASIAN SAJJAD KEH RAHY HAIN
SALAAR QAAFLA JO SO ZAKHM SEH RAHY HAIN
LOGO NA MARO PATHAR HAR IK MAQAAM SY
GUZREN GI KAISY ZAINAB BAZAAR E SHAM SY
english translation text:
SAJJAD (A.S.) IS SAYING THAT THESE ARE THE GRAND DAUGHTERS OF PROPHET MUHAMMAD (S.A)
THE LEADER OF THE CARAVAN HIMSELF IS ENDURING COUNTLESS WOUNDS
O PEOPLE, DON’T THROW STONES AT THEM FROM EVERY DIRECTION
HOW WILL BIBI ZAINAB(S.A.) PASS THROUGH THE BAZAR OF SHAM

arabic text:
JIS KO SALAM KHUD HI ALLAH KAR RAHY HAIN
US BIBION PY ZAALIM YEH ZULM DHA RAHY HAIN
MEHROOM KAR DIYA HAI UN KO SALAM SY
GUZREN GI KAISY ZAINAB BAZAAR E SHAM SY
english translation text:
THESE ARE THE ONES UPON WHOM ALLAH HIMSELF SENDS SALAAM
THE ENEMIES ARE OPPRESSING THESE VERY LADIES
THEY ARE NOT BEING GIVEN ANY RESPECT
HOW WILL BIBI ZAINAB(S.A.) PASS THROUGH THE BAZAR OF SHAM

arabic text:
SHAM E GHAREEBAN MEIN ZAINAB BUN GAI THI GHAZI
HAI AJ TK IMAMAT BAQI ZAKAAT UN KI
ABID KO JA K LAI JALTY KHAYAM SY
GUZREN GI KAISY ZAINAB BAZAAR E SHAM SY
english translation text:
ZAINAB HAD BECOME ABBAS (A.S.) ON SHAM E GAREEBAN
IT IS BECAUSE OF HER SERVICES THAT IMAMAT IS ALIVE TODAY
SHE BROUGHT IMAM SAJJAD (A.S.) FROM THE BURNING TENTS
HOW WILL BIBI ZAINAB (S.A.) PASS THROUGH THE BAZAR OF SHAM

arabic text:
ZAHRA KI SANI ZAINAB BAZAAR MEIN KHARHI HAIN
CHADAR NAHI HAI SAR PY GHAIRAT BHI RO RAHI HAIN
HAIN HATH AUR GARDAN BANDHAY LAGAAM SY
GUZREN GI KAISY ZAINAB BAZAAR E SHAM SY
english translation text:
THE SUCCESSOR OF BIBI FATIMA IS STANDING IN THE BAZAAR
SHE DOESN’T HAVE HER VEIL, EVEN MODESTY IS WEEPING
HER HANDS AND NECK ARE TIED WITH THE HORSE REIN
HOW WILL BIBI ZAINAB (S.A.) PASS THROUGH THE BAZAR OF SHAM

arabic text:
NOK E SINAAN PY NAATIQ QURAAN PARH RAHA HAI
AUR SUB KO YE KHABAR HAI WO HAQ PY BA KHUDA HAI
AANDHAY HUYE HAIN ZAALIM BS IK INAAM SY
GUZREN GI KAISY ZAINAB BAZAAR E SHAM SY
english translation text:
THE SPEAKING QURAN IS RECITING ON THE TIP OF A SPEAR
EVERYONE KNOWS THAT HE (A.S) IS ON THE RIGHT PATH
THE ENEMIES ARE BLINDED BY THE WORLDLY REWARDS
